method: Ridge corrections to two native output rows; internal weights fixed; not SFT
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% paired prompt bootstrap, not simultaneous. Same prompt order and bootstrap seed at every step. One fit; excludes seed/hardware uncertainty.
test_protocol: Only observed test endpoints; no interpolated test trajectory

manifest.condition_definition: Yes: gradient recording; No: no_grad; both eval, no activation probe
manifest.method: Fixed execution features; ridge correction of existing answer rows only
manifest.fit_targets: Individual answer logits from fixed pair mass and signed log odds

preservation.constraint: Both fitted answer logits retain pre-fit native values; many phase only
